### Specify the `Piece` object, which stores:

- the opera title,
- the time interval (as a frame range),
- subject intervals, where each subject is associated with a tracked
  heatmap time series.

<details open class="code-fold">
<summary>Exported source</summary>

``` python
dg0 = Piece(              
    title='Don Giovanni',
    time_interval=(14200,15200), 
    subjs=[(40, 44), (47,52), 53, 54, (56, 71), (73, 75)]
)
```

</details>

<div>

> **Note**
>
> `facebbox_t` is a `Datasource` object (`fhemb.dbms.db.Datasource`)
> used to access tracked face-bounding-box time-series data and derived
> embeddings. In this example, it contains 37 tracked time series of
> subjects {40, .., 76} who enjoyed *Don Giovanni* opera. All the time
> series are restricted to the segment of 1000 frames in the specified
> interval \[14200, 15200).

</div>
